Kohl & Kumkum — Bridal Makeup Studio, Jaipur

Kohl & Kumkum is a Jaipur bridal makeup studio offering traditional Rajasthani
bridal looks alongside contemporary HD makeup, with expertise in heavy
traditional jewelry styling and rajputi poshak draping.

Their bridal package (two events) is ₹60,000, including a trial and traditional
draping. Additional family makeup is billed per head.

Contact: +91 98291 80073 · hello@kohlandkumkum.example
Location: C-Scheme, Jaipur, Rajasthan
Rating: 4.6 / 5 (139 reviews)

What couples say:
"The rajputi poshak draping was authentic and beautifully done."

Kohl & Kumkum is a good fit for couples wanting a traditional Rajasthani bridal
